message.content: Farrah admires Rodri's standout performance in the midfield, highlighting his significant contributions to City's momentum and strategy. He praises Rodri for his ability to break up opposition plays and quickly transition the ball, noting that Rodri's control of the pace of the game is crucial to City's offensive setup. Farrah emphasizes Rodri's importance to City's success, suggesting that he has become an essential part of their system.
